name: Copper Country Cubing Winter 2020

venue.name: [Memorial Union - Michigan Tech University](https://www.mtu.edu/memorialunion/)
venue.details: MUB Ballroom - Sunday, MUB Alumni Lounge - Saturday

information: This will be the third Copper Country Cubing (Michigan Technological University) competition, in Michigan's great Upper Peninsula! The Memorial Union Building (MUB) is located between the middle and west end of the Michigan Tech campus. **The main events will take place on Sunday, March 1st** in the second floor ballroom. The Saturday events are in the first floor alumni lounge.
